Application Data.NAME: BrightLight Supply Co.
Application Data.NATURE OF BUSINESS: Wholesale distributor of lighting fixtures and supplies.
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: BrightLight Supply Co. specializes in the wholesale distribution of high-quality lighting fixtures and supplies. Our operations focus on sourcing products from reputable manufacturers, ensuring a controlled inventory that meets industry standards. We prioritize supply chain transparency and maintain strict documentation to track our inventory flow. Our customer base includes local retailers and contractors who rely on us for dependable product availability. We do not engage in online sales as the majority of our revenue is generated through direct business-to-business transactions. Our commitment to quality and compliance with safety regulations is paramount, and we avoid selling private-label or repackaged products to minimize liability risks.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 02/15/2023, the company experienced damage to its inventory due to a roof leak caused by severe weather, leading to an estimated loss of $2,500. The claim was filed with the previous carrier, Acme Lighting Solutions, and is currently under review for reimbursement.
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Controlled access through security fencing and monitored by watchpersons during off-hours to ensure inventory safety.

Underwriting Guidelines:
– Small-scale wholesalers or distributors with controlled inventory and documented supply
chain transparency.
• Not Acceptable:
– Businesses with 75% or more of revenue derived from online sales, due to increased risks
associated with shipping damage, fraud, and cyber liability.
– Entities engaged in the sale of private-label or repackaged lighting products, as these
often lack manufacturer warranties and increase product liability exposure.
– Operations heavily involved in complex electrical installations beyond basic lighting fix-
tures (e.g., full electrical rewiring), which require specialized underwriting beyond the
scope of a standard BOP.
